verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for an AI API and chat platform, but the evidence pack contains no documented opt-out control for telemetry, usage tracking or training-data use. The usage dashboard (mistral-docs-28) only reports billing consumption. Regional inference (mistral-docs-8) is a data-residency control, not an opt-out. Self-hosting open weights is a user-side workaround. None of these count toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
